messages:
Maya Patel: Quick thought — add a roundtrip calibration step when we change precision profiles. Current checks are forward-only; we should replay outputs through the quantized path and compare token-level deltas. :thinking:
Samir Gupta: you mean replay same prompts through new quant path and compute per-token drift? yes that would catch late-token drift
Lee Chen: love it. two quick wins: 1) golden prompt bank per model+task 2) provenance tag on each profile (commit, slice, cal-run)
Maya Patel: provenance = git:sha|slice:id|run:id so rollbacks are deterministic
Jorge Alvarez: ops: replaying at scale is costly. propose shadow replay on a sampled fraction and staged promotion
Samir Gupta: sampling + hysteresis. also a regen_budget to let routing trigger limited regenerations during rollout
Maya Patel: draft profile config:
```nprecision_profile:
 name: roundtrip-v1
 replay_calibrate: true
 sample_rate: 0.01
 regen_budget: 0.02
 provenance: "git:abc123|slice:golden-2026-02|run:20260203-5"
```
Lee Chen: telemetry: record token-wise signed-delta and a short fingerprint (sha256 of token sequence) for drift checks
Jorge Alvarez: need automated backstop: if drift>threshold for N minutes, auto-fallback to higher-bit variant + page on-call
Maya Patel: propose conservative thresholds initially: token_drift_pct>0.8 or mean_abs_delta>0.06 => fallback
Samir Gupta: useful CLI: `ri quant-calibrate --profile roundtrip-v1 --slice golden-2026-02` to run locally and produce artifact JSON
Lee Chen: artifact should include provenance, summary stats, sample fingerprints, and pass/fail flag for registry ingestion
Maya Patel: I'll write a short RFC amendment for profile lifecycle: calibration run metadata, replay sampler, regen_budget, fallback thresholds. pinging @Lee @Samir for review. :thumbsup:
